response.sql: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg FROM per_invoice) SELECT p.invoice_number, p.avg_quantity, p.relative_gap, p.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall_avg FROM per_invoice p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg ORDER BY (p.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg) IS NULL, diff_above_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text but holds numeric values, so it is cast to a number before averaging.
The overall average is the average of the per-invoice average quantities (each invoice weighted equally), not the average over all line items.

An invoice's relative gap is computed from its summed costs: (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / SUM(derived_total_cost). The request does not say whether to aggregate first or average per-line ratios.

alternatives.interpretation: The relative gap is the average of the per-line-item ratios (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / derived_total_cost within each invoice, rather than a ratio of sums.
